title: Crazyflie · bridge Webots↔Renode
description: Telemetría JSONL del bridge de CF_renode_emulator ingerida con bridge_to_influx.py

list.name: drone
list.label: Dron
list.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "bridge_cycle" and r._field == "cycle")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: (if exists r.drone then r.drone else "(sin etiqueta)")}))
  |> group()
  |> distinct(column: "_value")
list.definition:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "bridge_cycle" and r._field == "cycle")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: (if exists r.drone then r.drone else "(sin etiqueta)")}))
  |> group()
  |> distinct(column: "_value")

panels.title: Altitud (último valor)
panels.description: Última altitud de la planta (GPS de Webots) en el intervalo y sesiones seleccionados.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "bridge_cycle" and r._field == "alt")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: (if exists r.drone then r.drone else "(sin etiqueta)"), set: ${drone:json}))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with drone: (if exists r.drone then r.drone else "(sin etiqueta)")}))
  |> group(columns: ["drone"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "drone"])

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "bridge_event" and r._field == "detail")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: (if exists r.drone then r.drone else "(sin etiqueta)"), set: ${drone:json}))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with drone: (if exists r.drone then r.drone else "(sin etiqueta)")}))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "drone", "session", "kind", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "detalle", kind: "evento", session: "sesión", drone: "dron"})
